color-system.twistDescription: none — verbatim copy (fix-agent swap from dd-nyc: its white navText on white pageBackground failed contrast Check A)

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D (letter spacing on nav links): raised links letterSpacing from 0em to 0.08em for a tighter editorial cadence; no color changes.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A snappier hover transitions: all hover durations tightened ~100ms, clamped at 50ms min — button 200→100ms, link 250→150ms, navLink 130→50ms.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C easing-curve-swap: replaced all stepped easings (steps(1)/steps(6,start)/steps(6)/steps(10)) with a single decisive editorial cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) for confident, clean reveals — durations and keyframes unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B section breathing room: elements.section padding +32px (108->140 top, 120->152 bottom) for light bold-editorial B2B calm; all other spacing unchanged.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: injected 0.04em letter-spacing on all heading roles (h1-h4) — refined editorial tracking Nike's system lacked.

grid-system.twistDescription: Gap value scaling (expand) x1.4: all grid gutters widened 24px->34px for confident, airy editorial rhythm with B2B SaaS breathing room.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted the Geometric silhouettes paragraph to a more material register — shapes as physical removals cut by a blade, fiber and negative space felt.
